attempts.summary: Configured NFS export /srv/nfs/shared on node1 and mounted it at /mnt/shared on node2, both using shared identity dataops (uid/gid 4500) and directory mode 2770 with dataops:dataops ownership. Verified bidirectional file creation preserves consistent ownership/permissions, and root_squash correctly denies root access via NFS (only dataops uid/gid can read/write). Both nodes were then rebooted one at a time (server first, then client), boot-id changes confirmed actual restarts, and post-restart the NFS server, rpcbind, the client's fstab-persisted mount, and read/write access via dataops were all reverified healthy.
